    exact Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨by decide, hn⟩
  have hsum_eq :
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2 =
        (1 : ℝ) / (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 +
          ∑ i ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 n).erase 1, (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    simpa [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_erase (by decide) hmem_one]
  -- bound the remaining terms by a telescoping sum

      ∀ i ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 n).erase 1,
        (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / ((i - 1 : ℝ) * (i : ℝ)) := by
    intro i hi

      have : i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi
      rcases (Finset.mem_Icc).1 this with ⟨h1i, _⟩
      have hneq : i ≠ 1 := by
        intro h; have : i ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 n).erase 1 := hi

        intro h; exact hneq (by simpa [h])))

      exact_mod_cast (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.succ_pos 1) hi_ge_two)
    have hden_pos : 0 < ((i - 1 : ℝ) * (i : ℝ)) := by
      have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (i - 1 : ℝ) := by
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := by

            have : (i : ℕ) ≠ 1 := by
